intervals.locator: arXiv:2305.15593, section on the technical design
intervals.note: July 2022: ePIC collaboration formed to lead the technical design of the EIC project detector. "approved" here means selected as the EIC project detector; the end bound is the day before the first long-lead procurements (April 2024) that included detector components.
intervals.quote: a new detector collaboration: ePIC has been formed in July 2022 to lead the EIC project detector technical design based on the EIC reference design

intervals.label: collaboration: construction (long-lead procurement of detector components)
intervals.locator: BNL Newsroom, 13 April 2026 ("being designed and constructed"); CD-3A/CD-3B procurements include detector items (silicon photomultipliers, solenoid power supply, crystals, fibres, electronics)
intervals.note: BNL describes ePIC as "being designed and constructed" and the CD-3A/CD-3B packages buy detector components, but no source states the date the detector construction phase formally began; April 2024 is the date of the first approved procurements. The same BNL pages say the EIC is preparing a "formal transition into the construction phase".
intervals.quote: will be taken apart to make way for the new ePIC detector being designed and constructed for the Electron-Ion Collider

intervals.label: collaboration: operation (planned)
intervals.note: A 2023 expectation; no 2026 schedule was found, and the EIC project baseline (CD-2) had not been located, so the date may have moved.
intervals.quote: The EIC project detector is expected to start operate in 2032

website.quote: We are working together to build the world’s most sophisticated particle detector for analyzing collisions between electrons and protons or other nuclei.
